item.title: Lee White criticises Gabon's election practices
item.description: Former minister Lee White, now active in Scottish politics, described Gabonese elections as requiring 'dancing to get elected'.

item.title: Sunu Assurances Gabon promotes home insurance
item.description: The company presented home multi-risk and borrower death insurance products at the housing event.

item.title: Gabon begins resettlement for 100 families
item.description: Construction minister Lambert Mouvinde Millot launched work on a 15-hectare site in Akanda on October 31, 2026.

item.title: Gabon defends inequality observatory at UN forum
item.description: Justice Minister Augustin Emane presented Gabon's plan to measure anti-racism policies at the 5th Global Forum in The Hague.
